blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Valenzuela City will temporarily suspend the return of its no-contact apprehension policy (NCAP) on Monday, Oct. 5, citing ongoing road construction and changing traffic conditions, Mayor Wes Gatchalian said Saturday. Gatchalian said the city recognized the purpose of NCAP but that conditions were not yet suitable for its reimplementation. “Sunod-sunod ang road construction sa ating mga major roads, at araw-araw ay nagbabago ang daloy ng trapiko. Ayaw nating dagdagan ang pasanin ng ating mga motorista sa panahong hindi pa normal ang kondisyon ng ating mga kalsada,” he said in a Facebook post. “Unahin muna natin ang maayos at […]...
